question: Can four direction-specific RTX4090 service curves predict transfer time on independent physical repeats for every registered payload/path cell?
selection_policy: No physical sample, repeat, direction, payload, error sign, or failing cell may be excluded based on calibration outcome or the 10% threshold.

hardware_separation.calibration_model: single-node 2x NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090, PCIe pinned-host staged, float16
hardware_separation.separation_gate: The fitted RTX4090 curves live under an rtx4090_calibration namespace and never replace or mutate an A100 bandwidth, setup, capacity, workload, or topology field.

training_source.split_audit: Neither the physical manifest, staged contract, calibration JSON, nor gate report contains a train/holdout assignment or split hash. Assigning repeat ordinals after seeing all 80 measurements would be post hoc and is forbidden.
training_source.all_80_training_samples_rule: If calibration proceeds, all checksum-valid job141298 samples are used for fitting; none may be relabeled as holdout.

fit.unit: raw per-sample transfer_ms, not pre-aggregated GiB/s
fit.estimator: nonnegative least squares over all 20 job141298 samples for each direction
forbidden: shared bandwidth or setup parameter across directions
payload-specific lookup table with no held-out interpolation model
using holdout values during fitting or refitting after evaluation
reusing A100 configured values as RTX4090 acceptance predictions

holdout.collection_time: after this protocol hash is frozen
holdout.hardware_contract: same node class, two RTX4090 GPUs, pinned-host staged TCP engine, float16, TP1/PP1/system-DP2, and same four physical path classes as job141298
holdout.failure_rule: Any missing direction/payload/repeat, checksum failure, topology mismatch, or job lineage overlap blocks calibration evaluation; do not silently drop the sample or reduce the denominator.

holdout_statistics.reference_acceptance_gate: All 16 direction/payload MAPE values <= 10%; report FAIL without refitting or sample exclusion if any cell exceeds 10%.
holdout_statistics.aggregate_reporting: Also report per-direction MAPE over its 20 holdout samples and overall MAPE over all 80, but aggregate success cannot mask a failing direction/payload cell.
holdout_statistics.confidence_interval: Nonparametric bootstrap 95% CI over the five repetitions within each fixed direction/payload cell, seed frozen before holdout collection.

planned_artifacts: training_samples.csv with all 80 job141298 rows labeled FIT_ONLY
fitted_rtx4090_service_curves.json with four independent setup/bandwidth pairs and source hashes
holdout_samples.csv with exactly 80 new rows and immutable lineage
audit.json, manifest.json, SHA256SUMS, PDF, and PNG
evidence_boundary: This protocol separates an RTX4090 calibration-only simulator namespace from the A100 40 GiB main DES. Job141298 supplies fitting data only because it has no predeclared train/holdout split. No matched holdout accuracy or 10% acceptance result exists until a new independent 80-sample run completes.
